title: The Silent Distortion of Relative Prices
abstract: arXiv:2601.18544v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: This paper presents a production network model of inflationary dynamics in which inflation can have near-zero correlation with the size of price change yet generate significant distortions in relative prices. New money enters unevenly across firms and percolates through buyer-seller links, thereby displacing relative prices even when every price is free to adjust and every market clears. The magnitude of price distortion depends critically on the spectral gap of the production network, which sets the rate at which the economy converges to equilibrium. We quantify the mechanism on a reconstructed production network with the universe of firms in the United States. At 1% inflation, the typical firm's relative-price distortion is of the same magnitude as the inflation rate. The size of price change remains essentially uncorrelated with the magnitude of relative price distortion.

translated_abstract: 本文提出了一个关于通胀动态的生产网络模型，在该模型中，通胀可以与价格变动幅度近乎零相关，却仍会造成显著的相对价格扭曲。新货币在企业间不均匀地进入经济，并通过买卖双方的联系渗透扩散，从而即使在所有价格均可自由调整、所有市场均出清的情况下，也会使相对价格发生偏移。价格扭曲的程度关键取决于生产网络的谱隙，该谱隙决定了经济收敛至均衡的速度。我们在一个包含美国全体企业的重构生产网络上量化了这一机制。在1%的通胀率下，典型企业的相对价格扭曲与通胀率处于同一量级，而价格变动幅度与相对价格扭曲的程度基本不相关。
tldr: 本文构建了一个生产网络通胀模型，证明新货币不均匀进入经济并沿企业间买卖联系渗透，即使价格完全弹性、市场全部出清也会造成与价格变动幅度近乎无关的相对价格扭曲，其大小取决于生产网络的谱隙，且基于美国全体企业数据的量化结果显示1%通胀下典型企业的相对价格扭曲与通胀率处于同一量级。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a production network model of inflation in which unevenly injected money percolates through buyer-seller links, distorting relative prices even when all prices are fully flexible and all markets clear, with the distortion magnitude governed by the network's spectral gap and quantified to be roughly equal to the inflation rate itself for typical US firms.
